content:
Maya Singh: hey everyone :wave: I’m Maya, starting today on Eng-Platform. very excited to be here! quick issue — my Macbook got to the MDM enrollment screen and is asking for a device code. Anyone run into this?

onboarding-bot: Welcome, Maya! :tada: Please follow the new-hire checklist: https://intranet/redwood/onboarding. If MDM shows a device code prompt, DM eng-infra or reply here with the serial.

Diego Morales: welcome @Maya :raised_hands: I’m your manager — congrats! for the MDM prompt try rebooting to recovery and running the enrollment script we use. if that fails, ping eng-infra or drop the serial here and I’ll escalate.

Maya Singh: thanks Diego — serial is C02ABC123456. tried reboot, still stuck. happy to drop by infra desk if easier.

Ava Patel: hey Maya, welcome aboard! we usually have someone at the 10:30 onboarding check-in in #new-hires. also team lunch later if you want to join — tacos from the food truck :taco:.

Ben Carlson: FYI we keep spare USB-C adapters at eng-procurement in 3A. Also, badge pickup is front desk with Petra — bring a gov ID.

Jordan Lee: fun fact intro: I collect mechanical keyboards and can vouch for the tac9 switch :keyboard: Welcome!

Diego Morales: Maya — I can swing by the infra desk in 15m. If eng-infra needs to run the enrollment, they might ask for this command output first:

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial
```
If you paste the output here (or DM it), we’ll get infra moving.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: new hires should complete security training within 48h. Link: https://learning.redwood/sec-training.

Maya Singh: pasted serial and command output in DM to Diego. thanks all — excited to meet the team in person later! :smile:

Ava Patel: see you at lunch! :taco:

Ben Carlson: Welcome again — ping me if you want an intro to the observability dashboards.

Diego Morales: Putting a 1:1 on calendar for tomorrow. Also, quick welcome question for everyone — favorite snack for the team stash? I vote trail mix.

Jordan Lee: I vote spicy mango strips.

Maya Singh: chocolate-covered espresso beans (for those long model runs) :coffee:

Ben Carlson: trail mix for the win :thumbsup:

last note: Diego Morales: Maya, if the MDM enrollment still fails after infra, we’ll ship you a fresh image laptop same day.
